name: Simmerath (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, blue and yellow in the proportions 1:4:1, charged towards the hoist with the yellow figure of the municipal arms of Simmerath, a shield-shaped border with a letter S.
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne of 9 December 1975 the municipality of Simmerath was granted the right to bear arms, a seal, a flag and a banner; the hoisted flag is yellow, blue and yellow striped 1:4:1 with the figure shifted towards the staff.

features.role: shield-shaped border with letter S from the municipal arms
